description:
Advances: specled.coverage_capture

Found by the specled_-dn4.9 audit (2026-07-26T00:25:30Z, ruling N3 — the one genuinely unchartered behavior change in that ticket, judged advisory only because no specled-produced path reaches it).

dn4.9 item 14's mandate was the READ path (Store.classify_v2 rejecting a present non-map :meta), but the check also landed on the WRITE path in validate_envelope!/1, where an envelope missing :meta entirely now raises KeyError from a function documented to raise ArgumentError. A caller catching ArgumentError per the docs will not catch it.

Fix: add :meta to @v2_required_fields, or read it with Map.get/3 so the documented ArgumentError path is preserved. Pin with a test asserting the documented exception type.
title: Store.write_v2/2 raises KeyError on an envelope lacking :meta, contradicting its documented ArgumentError contract
